cover.title: Can family see the notes?
cover.kicker: Next of kin is not a right to information.

lines.say: Not just because they are family. Pause. Who can you share with?
Only the people involved in care, and only as much as they need.
Taking out the name is not enough. A detailed story can still identify someone.
And never discuss a patient on social media. Even with no name.
In Australia, the Privacy Act and state health records laws set the rules.
